recipe_title: Chili-Lime Cod Tacos with Black Beans and Slaw

details.title_candidate: Chili-Lime Cod Tacos with Black Beans and Slaw

details.summary: This is a superb, high-fiber, fast weeknight seafood recipe that aligns perfectly with the dietary philosophy of the book. The only needed adjustment is reducing the added salt slightly to clear the strict 550 mg sodium ceiling.

dimensions.feedback: The chili, lime, cod, avocado, and black bean flavor profile is a classic, coherent Mexican-American pairing with excellent balance of acid, fat, and spice.
Every listed ingredient is used in the steps exactly as expected, including the divided lime juice.
Excellent instructions. Ranges are provided for all cook times, visual cues ('pliable', 'golden and opaque') are present, and there is a clear mid-point check instruction.
Perfectly aligned with the stated Mexican-American style, utilizing corn tortillas, cilantro, avocado, and lime.
Dry-toasting tortillas and then quick-searing the cod in the same skillet is efficient and well-suited for a fast weeknight meal.

The automated check flagged sodium at 620 mg, exceeding the strict 550 mg chapter ceiling. While the recipe smartly uses no-salt-added beans, the 1/4 tsp added salt combined with the natural sodium of the fish and tortillas pushes it over the edge. Fix: Reduce the salt in the ingredient list to 1/8 tsp to reliably drop the sodium below the 550 mg threshold.
The title is accurate, and the intro perfectly matches the book's practical, food-focused tone without making any banned or overly clinical claims.
Highly appetizing. The contrast between the warm, spicy cod, creamy avocado, and crisp, bright slaw makes this an excellent, appealing meal.
A textbook example of addressing both conditions at once: lean protein from the cod, high-fiber complex carbohydrates from the beans and corn tortillas, and healthy fats from the EVOO and avocado.
Zero added sugar, and the total carbohydrate (50 g) sits beautifully in the target window (32-55 g). The carbs come entirely from high-quality sources (black beans, cabbage, corn tortillas).
Fits the 'Fish & Seafood Dinners' mandate perfectly, demonstrating how fast and accessible weeknight seafood can be.
Easily executable in under 20 minutes from a cold start. Using pre-shredded cabbage and canned beans keeps the prep lightning-fast. All ingredients are standard supermarket staples.
